verdict.rationale: The evidence shows MCP client support in Claude Code, the host platform, which can connect to MCP servers and bundle them in plugins. It does not show Skills itself, a SKILL.md instruction-packaging format, consuming MCP servers or their tools. Host-platform capabilities and adjacent plugin packaging earn no credit, so there is no direct evidence for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
